stem: Which headline describes an event that established guidelines for the admission of new states to the United States?
visual_elements: Images of four newspaper headlines titled 'The Daily Star' with the following headlines and dates: A: Northwest Ordinance Passed, July 13, 1787; B: Treaty of Paris Ratified, February 10, 1763; C: Bill of Rights Ratified, December 15, 1791; D: Alien and Sedition Acts Passed, November 13, 1797
